meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 安装后,Codex 在成功执行编辑类工具后会自动触发注释检查;若检查器报告警告,Codex 会先修复或解释被标记的注释,再继续后续工作。
howto.when: 当 Codex 成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑操作后,收到注释检查器的警告时触发。

say.text: 修复注释检查器标记的那条注释。
say.note: Codex 会先处理被标记的注释再继续。

say.text: 解释一下刚才改动里被标记的注释。
say.note: Codex 会说明该注释被标记的原因。

say.text: 根据检查器警告调整这段注释。
say.note: Codex 会按警告修改注释。

howto.what_en: After installation, Codex automatically runs comment-checker after successful edit-type tool calls. If it reports a warning, Codex must fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when Codex successfully uses edit-type tools such as apply_patch, write, edit, etc., and the comment-checker emits a warning.

say_en.text: Fix the comment flagged by the comment checker.
say_en.note: Codex will address the flagged comment before continuing.

say_en.text: Explain why the comment in this change was flagged.
say_en.note: Codex will explain the checker's warning.

say_en.text: Adjust this comment based on the checker warning.
